title: Core mechanic 5 - Recolecta (Collect)
description: Fifth core mechanic. Move with the stick to collect good shapes and avoid bad ones; reach the quota before the timer. Pure C# collect/quota logic; simple-shape prefab; MicrogameDefinition asset. Follows unity-microgame-framework skill.
acceptance_criteria: The stick moves the avatar to overlap collectible shapes; good shapes count up, bad shapes penalize.
Win condition: reach the quota within the time limit; loss otherwise. Collection/quota evaluation is unit-tested in pure C#.
A MicrogameDefinition asset registers it (verb e.g. '¡RECOLECTA!') and it runs through the sequencer.
